baseline_dogmas: Economic discount rates greater than zero correctly value the welfare of future humans.
Technological progress guarantees that future generations will always be richer and more capable than today.
human_blindspots: Zero constitutional representation for humans born after the year 2060
Irreversible planetary boundary depletion treated as non-cost externalities on corporate balance sheets

unasked_questions.question: What would global GDP look like if it subtracted every unpayable environmental debt transferred to our grandchildren?
How can democratic parliaments create binding veto power for ministers representing unborn generations?
